scope: User-supplied decisions only; no labels generated. Rates use fully reviewed rows in each group; absent reviews yield null rates. Reviewer identifiers and notes are excluded.
limitation: One user review of eight answers from six synthetic documents; no representative accuracy, inter-rater calibration or general citation-faithfulness claim.
unanswerable_citation_scope: Unanswerable citation assessments are separate from citation support for the six factual answers; do not pool them into a factual citation-accuracy claim.
